issue.title: Bug:  docker-restapi-watchdog build fails due to MSRV bump, blocking CI

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

`docker-restapi-watchdog` build fails on current master, blocking the CI/CD pipeline.

The Rust project at `dockers/docker-restapi-watchdog/watchdog/` does not have a `Cargo.lock` file committed. Without a lockfile, `cargo build` resolves transitive dependencies to their latest semver-compatible versions.

The dependency chain is: `redis 0.23.3` → `url` → `idna` → `icu_*`. The `icu_*` crates recently released v2.2.0 which bumped their minimum supported Rust version (MSRV) to 1.86. The Dockerfile pins rustc to 1.83.0, so the build fails.

`docker-gnmi-watchdog` has the same missing `Cargo.lock` problem and is vulnerable to the same class of breakage, though it is not currently broken because its sole dependency (`chrono`) does not pull in `icu_*`.

For comparison, `docker-bmp-watchdog` and `docker-telemetry-watchdog` already have `Cargo.lock` files committed and are not affected.

### Steps to Reproduce

See recent CI/CD builds.

Sample PR blocked: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/26498
Build Logs:
- Broadcom: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/26498/checks?check_run_id=69573581963
- marvell_prestera_armhf: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/26498/checks?check_run_id=69571778603

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual: Broadcom / marvell_prestera_armhf builds fail. This also blocks CI/CD Pipeline
Expected: Build goes through successfully

### Relevant log output

```shell
Actual behavior: `cargo build --release` fails inside the docker-restapi-watchdog Dockerfile with:

error: rustc 1.83.0 is not supported by the following packages:
  icu_collections@2.2.0 requires rustc 1.86
  icu_locale_core@2.2.0 requires rustc 1.86
  icu_normalizer@2.2.0 requires rustc 1.86
  icu_normalizer_data@2.2.0 requires rustc 1.86
  icu_properties@2.2.0 requires rustc 1.86
  icu_properties_data@2.2.0 requires rustc 1.86
  icu_provider@2.2.0 requires rustc 1.86

Expected behavior: build completes successfully.
```

### Output of `show version`, `show techsupport`


resolution.title: [watchdog]: Add Cargo.lock files for restapi and gnmi watchdogs
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it

Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/26513

`docker-restapi-watchdog` build fails on current master because the `icu_*` crates released v2.2.0 with MSRV 1.86, while the Dockerfile pins `rustc` to 1.83.0. We need a `Cargo.lock` to pin the `icu_*` version as well.

`docker-gnmi-watchdog` has the same missing lockfile and is vulnerable to identical breakage from any future MSRV bump in its dependency tree.

Note `docker-bmp-watchdog` and `docker-telemetry-watchdog` already commit `Cargo.lock` files and are unaffected — this PR brings the remaining two watchdogs in line with that convention.

#### How I did it
* Generated `Cargo.lock` for `dockers/docker-restapi-watchdog/watchdog/` and downgraded `icu_*` crates from v2.2.0 to v2.1.x (MSRV 1.83) to match the Dockerfile-pinned `rustc` version.
* Generated `Cargo.lock` for `dockers/docker-gnmi-watchdog/watchdog/`.

#### How to verify it
CI/CD builds for Broadcom and marvell_prestera_armhf targets should pass.

#### Description for the changelog
Add Cargo.lock files for docker-restapi-watchdog and docker-gnmi-watchdog to prevent build failures from transitive MSRV bumps.
